messages.subject: Lovisa | Director-Level Corporate Affairs & ESG Executive | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Lovisa,

I am reaching out because your HR Business Partner role for Corporate Functions at Investor AB makes you a relevant contact for senior profiles spanning sustainability, corporate affairs, institutional relations and strategic stakeholder leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major international mining operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. This combination has given me a strong perspective on institutional trust, governance, sustainability, major investment interfaces and long-term stakeholder value.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track opportunities across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations and related corporate functions. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached an Investor AB-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or future corporate-function opportunities, or referral to the appropriate colleague within Investor or its portfolio network.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
